mechanism_definition.inherited_components: DIN-inspired target-aware category/brand history pooling, behavior/time context, shared embeddings, masked-softmax attention, normalized explicit field products, mean BCE and Adam under the host recipe.
mechanism_definition.gradient_change: scale_half_tangent preserves recipient tangent directions but reassigns inverse-norm scales by stable inverse-norm rank and half rotation within eligible histories. It preserves the eligible scalar scale multiset and its first/second moments. The name does not mean multiplying the whole gradient by one half.
mechanism_definition.none: row_intervention=none removes complete-row projection/magnitude operations; the half-tangent product backward rule remains active.
mechanism_definition.latest_change: When autograd is disabled, bypass donor/surrogate construction whose purpose is to alter backward derivatives. Keep the forward normalized product; preserve the enabled-gradient path according to receipt notes and bounded synthetic checks.
mechanism_definition.historical_magnitude: Complete shared-row gradient G is scaled by ||P||/||G|| for guarded projected target P. Raw-gradient direction preservation does not preserve an Adam update direction or its subsequent trajectory.
mechanism_definition.scope: Mechanism description comes from registered configurations, earlier original memory and execution diagnostics. No unavailable source rederivation is claimed.

observations.statement: All 90 authorized own-arm receipts resolve: 86 successes and four trace-v1 execution failures. Runtime history and indexed status/AUC/wall fields agree with receipts. Replays and source variants are dependent observations at declared seed 42.

Latest flag-on/off pair has exactly equal reported population AUC/Logloss, all 23 slice dictionaries, parameter counts and peak GPU memory. Both retain the round30 aligned-half slice records. Aggregate equality does not certify equal per-example predictions.

Recorded inference time decreases by 0.3991248459 seconds (2.13818%); throughput increases by 2.18490%. Batch p50 falls by 0.4709065 ms (2.14216%) and p95 by 0.2583563 ms (1.13669%). Wall time instead rises by 0.4001617 seconds and training by 1.6404516 seconds. One pair is a timing observation with unresolved execution variation.

Both schema9 diagnostic records succeed and report 37 finite scalars; only inference_shortcut_enabled differs. On 512 ordered validation impressions with 60,475 valid events and four empty histories, reported helper/product/active-logit errors and masked mass/empty-summary norms are zero. No natural floor/boundary events occur in this sample.

Both report zero shortcut synthetic no-grad product error and enabled-gradient product/VJP errors, finite fraction 1, four synthetic floor cases and one boundary case. The inherited analytic VJP relative errors are about 1.44e-16. These are bounded candidate-authored checks, not independent verification of every model state.

The accumulated aligned-half/no-row quality anchor exceeds the original target-aware reference by 0.0017402023884 AUC and reduces Logloss by 0.0002620625394. That contrast bundles inherited changes; round31 adds no score improvement.

The common-family four-cell contrast has half-minus-full AUC +0.0001204973277 aligned and +0.0004667050401 crossed. Crossed-minus-aligned interaction is +0.0003462077124 at seed 42. Both losses improve, and aligned half has the best population metrics among these four cells.

Aligned half improves 15/23 slice AUCs and 16/23 losses; crossed half improves 20/23 AUCs and 23/23 losses. Aligned empty and 1–16-history slices regress on both metrics. Uniform subgroup superiority is contradicted; empty-history effects may reflect shared learned parameters and do not establish an active history mechanism.

Baseline static/pooled/target-aware AUCs are 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861. Full count correction loses in both backbones; partial correction helps pooling but loses target-aware AUC. The proposed correction did not transfer uniformly across architectures.

Aligned products and normalization improve this local trajectory; constant/history-mean derivative controls nearly match fuller normalization. Combined half routing outperforms query-only or history-only variants on AUC. These contrasts leave generic conditioning and shared-embedding adaptation plausible.

The historical magnitude maximum AUC 0.6152795937 was not reproduced by its exact-source replay (0.6149279139). Round26 magnitude has a small positive delta +0.0000243280764, while frozen round27 has delta -0.0001685358866 and worse loss. Same-source round23 duplicates also differ. Preserve positives, negatives and lineage; no reliable incremental magnitude advantage is established.
Direction-only, rotated-magnitude and uniform-energy interventions lose AUC to their none comparators. These controls concern raw gradients and do not match actual Adam updates.

Candidate-owned same-state magnitude shadows show tiny role/gradient/moment changes. A represented Adam-update difference of 1.4901161193847656e-8 is reported at call512; early calls0/1 and call8192 update differences are zero. Fixed-tree aggregation is shadow-only. The new inference result does not establish training-wide numerical repair or final-score mediation.

Observer removal in round28 retains reported parent population/slice metrics with lower recorded cost. Round31 supplies a contemporaneous control for a different optimization, inference surrogate removal; it does not retroactively deconfound the older observer timing contrast.

Four trace-v1 jobs fail with RuntimeError('Trace v1 supports float32/64 only; preserve failure') before validation. Their combined wall time is 21.4754219353 seconds. Metrics and unreported train/memory costs remain null, not zero or scientific losses.

Latest knowledge usage is documented; both executed IDs, variant names, source hashes and statuses match committed receipts. This checks declared source-to-execution provenance, not causal knowledge value or scientific truth.
